overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures premium dehydrated red onion granules from carefully selected Indian red onions. Processed through controlled dehydration and precision sieving, our 16-26 mesh granules deliver authentic savory aroma and uniform dispersion. They eliminate labor-intensive peeling and prep waste while maintaining reliable formulation consistency for dry seasonings, ready meals, and commercial food production.

As an FSSAI-registered manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter, TradeNest Naturals provides full export documentation support and bulk supply. We follow a strict six-step manufacturing process from raw material sourcing to final dispatch. With moisture maintained at or below eight percent, our shelf-stable red onion granules ensure long storage stability, low freight bulk, and dependable industrial performance.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for this product?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity is 5 kg, supporting trial batches as well as recurring full-container industrial orders.

faqs.q: What are the standard mesh size and moisture parameters?
faqs.a: Our standard granulation is 16-26 mesh with moisture capped at 8%. Alternative mesh sizes are available on request.

faqs.q: Do you offer private-label and OEM packaging services?
faqs.a: Yes, we supply OEM and private-label packaging in small pouches, jars, and customized bulk packaging based on buyer specifications.

faqs.q: What processing method is utilized for these granules?
faqs.a: We employ a six-step process comprising sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and dispatch.

faqs.q: Can we request product samples for evaluation?
faqs.a: Yes, samples are available on request to assist with recipe development, quality checks, and technical evaluation.

faqs.q: What export documentation support do you provide?
faqs.a: As an IEC-registered exporter, we issue standard export documentation including product data sheets, packing lists, and consignment papers.
